summary: Platform gateway RBAC delegates access to inventories, organizations and credentials so users can use secrets without seeing them. Roles are collections of capabilities; users get capabilities only through assigned or inherited roles, all role members get all of its capabilities, and a user can hold many roles.
questions: How does RBAC work in AAP?
